title: Kissed Dutch Pineapple Poffertjes
description: Fluffy, festive Dutch poffertjes featuring grilled pineapple chunks and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and granulated sugar. Set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a yakimono-grill or non-stick pan over medium heat and coat with non-stick cooking spray.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Flip the poffertjes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
While the poffertjes are cooking, grill the pineapple chunks on the yakimono-grill or in a pan with a little bit of butter until caramelized.
Once the poffertjes are cooked, brush with melted honey and sprinkle with vanilla extract.
Serve the poffertjes warm with grilled pineapple chunks on top.
Repeat the process until all the batter is used up and serve immediately.
